column2: [intro]
This morning, I broke my cup,
But I laughed, no need to fuss,
My cat knocked over my glass,
But it's okay, let it pass.
It's a pity, but it's fine,
We leave worries behind,
Life plays tricks, but who cares!
As long as we have fun, we're aware.
I missed the train to Paris,
But I met a lovely spirit,
I wore a pink sweater instead of blue,
But it's okay, being joyful’s better, it's true.
It's a pity, but it's fine,
We leave worries behind,
Life plays tricks, but who cares!
As long as we have fun, we're aware.
